text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak hold private talks on Middle East and Jerusalem issues.
- Morocco's opposition CDT trade union opens its third congress in Casablanca.
- Egyptian president arrived in Rabat on Friday for talks with King Hassan II on bilateral and international issues.
- Morocco expresses reserves and refuses modification of initial U.N. peace plan on Western Sahara dispute.
- Morocco denounces before United Nations the biased position of non-government organisations towards Western Sahara issue.
- France expels plane with illegal Moroccan immigrants.
- Morocco's fuel stations to go on 24-hour strike next week.
